scaffold.usage_contract: required nonnegative integer completion_tokens from provider; includes reasoning tokens when provider counts them in completion_tokens; do not add reasoning tokens twice
scaffold.budget_failure: retry only failed stage once on invalid/missing usage, exceeded cap or exhausted MS budget; abort case after exhaustion without executing failed output
scaffold.budget_scope: accepted MS/action output cap; discarded failed generations add fully recorded cost, not matched FLOPs or input tokens
scaffold.ms_memory: no independent MS history; native final assistant responses remain in native history
scaffold.request_layout: native observation/history view with action directives removed from system/users; user MS; actual assistant belief; user ACTION restores original action protocol and current directives
scaffold.context_projection: pinned CalBench template sections, not scenario strategy; preserve visible facts and past assistant submissions; unknown instruction-bearing templates abort before generation
scaffold.belief_output: natural-language paragraph only; JSON/code/tool or action objects rejected, never stripped into belief
scaffold.stage_execution: MS is private and is not executed or counted as pass; only final ACTION response is submitted
scaffold.persistence: temporary stage messages never mutate native history; return only final action response to original client for its original persistence policy
scaffold.analysis_failure: retry failed MS prompt once including output-format violations; no invalid MS forwarded; if both fail abort case and continue suite
scaffold.action_failure: retry only failed action prompt once with accepted MS unchanged; native parser/decision retry retained
scaffold.seed_policy: action uses original native seed sequence; MS uses SHA256(native seed:ms)
scaffold.privacy: only native visible messages; MS is private and never executed
